## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 36-fascicle composite work combines [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Dà bān niè pán jīng shū* 大般涅槃經疏 ([KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007)) with [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's Táng-period editorial revision (*zài zhì* 再治) and the Japanese editorial *fēn huì* of [本純](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%AC%E7%B4%94) Honjun. The 36-fascicle scope matches the *Southern Recension* of the parent sūtra ([KR6g0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0003)) and provides line-by-line interlinear commentary.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (597–1700) reflects the maximum window from Guàndǐng's mature period to the Edo-Japanese editorial work.
